reason: Provides a Web settings editor for user habits, storing them in the user-global AGENTS.md file so the existing instruction loader can include them in sessions.

summaries.zh: 在 Web 设置中编辑用户习惯，并将内容保存到全局 AGENTS.md 以供会话指令加载器使用。
summaries.en: Adds a Web settings editor for user habits and saves them to the global AGENTS.md file for inclusion by the session instruction loader.

capabilities: Adds a Web settings editor for user habits
Reads and atomically updates the user-global AGENTS.md instruction document
Uses an existing loader to apply saved instructions to sessions
